record.field:
Update a Drift Alert record (saltstack.alert) with assessment and status. Use to save the AI diagnosis conclusion, set the status, mark as resolved, and leave an action plan.
Set `outcome` to what the alarm TURNED OUT to be - not what you first suspected. That is what teaches the system: 'acted' and 'false_positive' are written back as experience on the skills whose trigger keywords matched the alarm. Use 'false_positive' whenever the alarm was noise (transient spike, known maintenance, restart wave).
